cases.scenario: A household burr grinder produces two repeatable grind-size bands, but its exported calibration profile does not identify which installed burr set generated them.
observations: Two independent calibration runs reproduce the same paired grind-size bands.
The export includes motor timing and dial position.
No visible field binds the profile to the installed burr-set identity.
uncertainties: Whether the profile belongs to the currently installed burr set remains unresolved.
cases.task: Identify the exact local calibration-to-burr binding path without changing grinder behavior.
cases.proof: Require a fixture binding burr identity, calibration export, a negative mismatched-burr case, and restart readback.
cases.workerFinding: The dossier locates the profile reader but does not prove the exact burr-identity binding or restart behavior.

cases.scenario: A graded comic record carries two independently captured certification entries that assign different grades to the same certification number.
observations: Both entries reproduce the same certification number.
One sealed capture reports grade 8.5 and another reports grade 9.2.
Neither visible capture establishes supersession or revocation.
uncertainties: Which grade, if either, is authoritative remains unresolved.
cases.task: Trace the exact certification selection path and preserve conflicting grades.
cases.proof: Require exact-path provenance, conflict retention, a negative supersession case, and restart persistence.
cases.workerFinding: The selected-grade claim conflicts with the dossier's own retained certification capture.

cases.scenario: A smart thermostat imports one weekly schedule with every time block assigned to the following weekday.
observations: The source schedule is ordered Monday through Sunday.
The imported schedule assigns Monday's blocks to Tuesday and continues cyclically.
Temperature values remain unchanged while weekday indices shift by one.
uncertainties: No second independent occurrence is visible.
cases.task: Bound the weekday-index translation path without changing thermostat control logic.
cases.proof: Require exact-path, seven-day fixture, negative no-shift case, and restart readback proof.
cases.workerFinding: All requested offline proofs support the bounded weekday-index correction.

cases.scenario: A countertop ice maker reports its cleaning cycle complete before the durable sanitation-state record survives a controller restart.
observations: Two cleaning cycles emit completion before durable sanitation-state readback.
The in-memory state appears complete immediately.
After restart the durable record still shows the prior cycle.
uncertainties: The precise commit boundary must be confirmed by exact-path proof.
cases.proof: Require exact commit path, negative premature-completion case, and restart durability proof.
cases.workerFinding: The dossier proves completion follows the durable sanitation commit and survives restart.

cases.scenario: An electronic shelf label acknowledges a price refresh before the durable label-to-price index records the new value.
observations: Two refreshes acknowledge the updated price while the durable index retains the prior value.
The display buffer shows the requested price.
A later index readback exposes the stale durable mapping.
uncertainties: Restart persistence has not yet been demonstrated.
cases.task: Bound the acknowledgement and durable price-index ordering path.
cases.proof: Require exact local path first, followed by negative and restart proofs.
cases.workerFinding: The exact local acknowledgement path is proven, but negative and restart evidence remain incomplete.

cases.scenario: An inherited jewelry chain has a dated appraisal and intact storage seal but no signed handoff between the estate custodian and the current holder.
observations: The appraisal predates the current possession record.
The storage seal is intact at intake.
The intervening custody handoff has no signature or equivalent attestation.
uncertainties: Continuous custody cannot be established from the supplied evidence.
cases.task: Determine whether any sealed local record can establish the missing custody handoff.
cases.proof: Require a signed or equivalently attributable handoff record without inferring provenance.
cases.workerFinding: No sealed local handoff record is available.

cases.scenario: Three imported power-bank records treat capacities expressed in milliamp-hours as if the numeric values were amp-hours.
observations: Each source labels capacity in mAh.
The normalized records preserve the number but relabel the unit as Ah.
The resulting capacity is inflated by a factor of one thousand.
uncertainties: Only the sealed import path is in scope.
cases.task: Locate the unit-normalization branch for power-bank capacity.
cases.proof: Require exact mAh-to-Ah conversion proof, negative compatible-unit coverage, and restart-stable output.
cases.workerFinding: The dossier proves the bounded unit conversion and all requested negative and restart cases.

cases.scenario: Two provenance packets for one collectible coin claim different excavation origins while sharing the same inventory identifier.
observations: Both packets use the same coin inventory identifier.
One packet names a coastal excavation and the other an inland estate.
No visible supersession record resolves the conflict.
uncertainties: The coin's supported origin remains unresolved.
cases.task: Trace provenance selection while preserving mutually exclusive origins.
cases.proof: Require exact origin-source selection, conflict retention, negative supersession proof, and restart persistence.
cases.workerFinding: The dossier selects the coastal origin while retaining an equally bound inland-origin packet.

cases.scenario: A household photo backup reports completion before its durable catalog includes every copied image.
observations: Two backups emit completion while the durable catalog omits the final image.
The copied file is present in temporary storage.
A restart reads the incomplete prior catalog.
uncertainties: The catalog commit boundary must be verified without inspecting private image content.
cases.task: Locate the completion-to-catalog commit ordering boundary.
cases.proof: Require exact catalog path, negative incomplete-catalog case, and restart durability proof.
cases.workerFinding: The dossier proves catalog durability precedes completion and survives restart.

cases.scenario: A family audio collection contains two signed permissions for the same recordings with different publication audiences.
observations: Both permissions identify the same recording set.
One allows family-only access and the other permits public exhibition.
Neither document states that it supersedes the other.
uncertainties: The controlling publication scope requires an authorized human judgment.
cases.task: Identify whether a sealed supersession record resolves the permission conflict.
cases.proof: Require attributable supersession evidence or explicit exceptional-human authority.
cases.workerFinding: No sealed supersession record is available.

cases.scenario: A digitized vinyl pressing has calibrated audio samples but does not identify the equalization profile applied during capture.
observations: The audio sample checksum and capture rate are present.
The equipment record identifies the cartridge.
No record names the playback equalization profile.
uncertainties: Frequency-response conclusions depend on the unknown profile.
cases.task: Search sealed local capture metadata for the equalization profile identity.
cases.proof: Require an attributable profile identity and negative wrong-profile fixture before any frequency-response claim.
cases.workerFinding: The capture reader is identified, but no attributable equalization profile is present.

cases.scenario: Three kitchen-scale calibration rotations map the left load-cell channel onto the right reading and the right channel onto the left reading.
observations: Three independent rotations reproduce the channel swap.
Calibration magnitudes remain within tolerance.
Only channel identity changes after rotation.
uncertainties: The correction must remain confined to the calibration mapping boundary.
cases.task: Locate the load-cell channel mapping after calibration rotation.
cases.proof: Require exact mapping path, asymmetric-load fixture, negative no-rotation case, and restart proof.
cases.workerFinding: The dossier proves the bounded mapping correction with all requested fixtures and restart readback.

cases.scenario: A handheld camping GPS export records elevation values without declaring the vertical datum used by the device.
observations: Latitude, longitude, timestamp, and elevation values are present.
The export identifies the coordinate format but not a vertical datum.
No companion metadata file supplies the missing datum.
uncertainties: Elevation cannot be compared safely across datum systems without the missing identity.
cases.task: Trace the sealed export parser for any attributable vertical-datum field.
cases.proof: Require an explicit datum identity and a negative mismatched-datum case before comparative elevation claims.
cases.workerFinding: The parser path is identified, but the source contains no attributable vertical datum.

cases.scenario: A museum storage rack reports an artifact-bin move complete before the durable rack map reflects the destination bin.
observations: Two moves emit completion while the durable map retains the source bin.
The motion controller reports the destination reached.
Restart readback restores the stale source-bin mapping.
uncertainties: Returned evidence may conflict about whether durability precedes completion.
cases.task: Locate the move-completion and durable rack-map ordering boundary.
cases.proof: Require exact commit path, negative premature-completion case, and restart durability proof.
cases.workerFinding: The dossier claims durable commit precedes completion but its restart evidence reads the prior source-bin mapping.
